mainEntity.name: What does Niagara Health System specialize in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Niagara Health System specializes in treating mental health issues, substance abuse, and drug and alcohol addiction.

mainEntity.name: What kind of therapies are offered at Niagara Health System?

acceptedAnswer.text: Niagara Health System offers a range of therapies, including evidence-based practices, individual therapy, family therapy, group therapy, art therapy, nature therapy, nutritional counseling, and yoga and meditation.

mainEntity.name: What is the 12-step program offered by Niagara Health System?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 12-step program is a popular approach to addiction recovery that emphasizes the importance of spirituality, personal growth, and community support. It is one of the amenities offered by Niagara Health System.

Outpatient drug rehab is a form of addiction treatment that allows individuals to receive treatment while still living at home. This type of rehab offers more flexibility and less disruption to daily life.

mainEntity.name: What is the mission of Niagara Health System?

acceptedAnswer.text: Niagara Health System’s mission is to provide quality, compassionate care to individuals struggling with addiction and mental health issues, with the aim of achieving long-term recovery.

mainEntity.name: What is the holistic approach to addiction treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: The holistic approach to addiction treatment aims to address the physical, emotional, and spiritual aspects of recovery. Niagara Health System uses this approach to provide comprehensive care to individuals struggling with addiction.

mainEntity.name: What kind of professionals work at Niagara Health System?

acceptedAnswer.text: Niagara Health System employs a team of experienced professionals, including therapists, counselors, and addiction specialists, who are dedicated to helping patients achieve long-term recovery.

about_blocks.text: Niagara Health System is a public rehabilitation center based in Welland, Ontario, that specializes in treating mental health, substance abuse, and drug and alcohol addiction. The center offers a range of therapies, including evidence-based practices, individual therapy, family therapy, group therapy, art therapy, nature therapy, nutritional counseling, and yoga and meditation. Their holistic approach to addiction treatment aims to address the physical, emotional, and spiritual aspects of recovery.
about_blocks.html: Niagara Health System is a public rehabilitation center based in Welland, Ontario, that specializes in treating mental health, substance abuse, and drug and alcohol addiction. The center offers a range of therapies, including evidence-based practices, individual therapy, family therapy, group therapy, art therapy, nature therapy, nutritional counseling, and yoga and meditation. Their holistic approach to addiction treatment aims to address the physical, emotional, and spiritual aspects of recovery.

about_blocks.text: The center offers a variety of amenities, including 12-step programs, family services, and outpatient drug rehab. The 12-step program is a popular approach to addiction recovery that emphasizes the importance of spirituality, personal growth, and community support. Family services provide support to the families and loved ones of those struggling with addiction. Outpatient drug rehab allows individuals to receive treatment while still living at home, allowing for more flexibility and less disruption to daily life.
